summary.whatChanges: In the Vitest UI test explorer's filtering logic, when a non-file node is expanded, the owning file node is now included in the matched-node set if the file itself matches the current search/filter. The rest of the diff adds explanatory comments/TODOs and a UI e2e assertion that searching hides non-matching files.
behaviorChanges: When expanding a nested suite/test while a search or filter is active, the parent file row is now kept visible if the file name itself matches the filter
Explorer entry lists for expanded subtrees can include the owning file node that was previously omitted
UI e2e test now verifies that typing a search term removes non-matching files (sample.test.ts) from the explorer
risks: Adding the file ID to the matched set could produce duplicate or unexpectedly visible rows in the flattened explorer list
Behavior depends on the matcher treating file nodes consistently; a matching file may now pull in entries users expect to be filtered out
Only one e2e assertion covers the new path; other expand+filter combinations remain untested
